Senior Product Manager - Platform & Payments
PhonePe
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

About PhonePe:
PhonePe is India's leading digital payments and financial services platform.

Responsibilities:
• Drive product strategy and platform roadmap for high-throughput payment processing engines.
• Partner with engineering architects on system design, microservices, and distributed systems.
• Own business case, unit economics, P&L, and vendor management for banking partner integrations.
• Manage stakeholder relationships across compliance, risk, and executive leadership.

Requirements:
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in product management with enterprise/fintech systems.
• Education: Strictly Tier-1 engineering colleges (IIT / BITS / NIT) or IIM graduates only.
• Deep technical depth in APIs, microservices, and high-scale architecture.
• Proven track record managing cross-functional teams in high-growth environments.
